5256-7084-8347.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4050-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4050-5254-6627.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-4186-5662--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

618-3305-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

671-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1479-5033-7705.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-7705.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a Minion creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1545-3490-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

500-804-1181-3191.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima the Impostor and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima the Impostor tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-804-1181-3191.notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

240-997-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

2463-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4446-4681-5147-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-4681-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4929-5224-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
4929-5224-7096.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

719-2366-6797-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-6797-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

549-856-2829-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-3108-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.
628-3108-3967.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

880-6517-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6517-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3457-4613-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
3457-4613-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

66-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
Artificer Class is level three.
66-1329-3169-4050.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class triggers, creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
During your next turn, cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-2034-2741.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-2741.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2533-2719-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

437-509-2750-2751-4131.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2750-2751-4131.description:
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

2068-2232-3866-5502.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
2068-2232-3866-5502.description:
Activate Akul the Unrepentant by sacrificing three creatures.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Akul the Unrepentant's ability.
Resolve the copy of Akul the Unrepentant's ability, putting Abhorrent Overlord from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Abhorrent Overlord trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Harpy creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
When the Harpys enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from step 4, returning Akul the Unrepentant from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Akul the Unrepentant's ability from step 1, putting it onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Akul the Unrepentant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Abhorrent Overlord from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

859-4613-5162.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
859-4613-5162.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kwain's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing each opponent to do the same.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

391-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3478-3525.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
